query:
SELECT ph.id, ph.card_id, ph.grade, ph.price, ph.jpy_price, ph.sold_at, ph.source, c.name_jp, c.set_code
FROM price_history ph
JOIN cards c ON ph.card_id = c.id
WHERE c.name_jp LIKE '%サトシのピカチュウ%'
  AND ph.grade = 'PSA10'
ORDER BY ph.sold_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
